target_definition: All current members of Garden Club North during May.
time_bounds: Snapshot exported 31 May; relation to all current May members is not established beyond that date.

coverage_entries.unit_or_channel: Members with an email account in the club portal
coverage_entries.supporting_rule: Inclusion rule: members with an email account in the club portal.
coverage_entries.limitation: Inclusion does not establish coverage of all current members.
The number of excluded members is unknown.

coverage_entries.unit_or_channel: All current May members without a portal account
coverage_entries.limitation: Whether all current members use the portal is unknown.

duplicate_risks.mechanism: A member can have both a personal and work portal account.
duplicate_risks.consequence: One member may appear through more than one account; counts of occurrences may exceed counts of members.

unknown_coverage: Whether all current May members use the portal.
The number of paper-only members and duplicate occurrences.
verification_findings: The frame is bounded to the 31 May snapshot.
No representativeness, bias magnitude, population size, or duplicate count is established.
Actions outside scope: sampling, weighting, deduplication, and external contact.
